meta.model_2: Pauli-twirl model from F1's own TOMO-9 matrices (Fez); K4's measured z under DD (Kingston)
success_criteria: G1 (pre-registered): the same-job gap D = F(N1corr) - F(native) per state, with its sigma; REAL is favoured if D is closer to the F2 - F1 value, DRIFT if closer to model 2's (likelihood ratio, Gaussian, shot sigma); the fingerprint-only correction tests whether removing Fez's own rotation alone raises F
G2 (pre-registered): fit z(t) = a + b t on each leg (4, 8, 16 us); CONST is favoured if b is consistent with 0 and LINEAR if a is consistent with 0 (each at 2 sigma); both or neither -> undecided
